fields.name: ClusteringExtensions.UseArgentSeaClustering (IClientBuilder)
fields.contract: Configures an Orleans client builder for ArgentSea clustering. It applies a non-null Action<IConfiguration> to service configuration before registering singleton IMembershipTable resolution as ArgentSeaOrleansMembershipTable and singleton IConfigurationValidator resolution as ClusterOptionsValidator; a null action is skipped. The method returns the configured IClientBuilder.
